results.optimization: Added vec4 vectorized memory access (sycl::vec<float, 4>) for all column loops
results.notes: Vec4 vectorization for max/exp/norm loops with tail handling. Correctness: 212/212 tests. Peak bandwidth ~262 GB/s (~57% theoretical). Memory-bound kernel already well-optimized.

results.optimization: Added reqd_sub_group_size + replaced manual reduction with reduce_over_group
results.notes: Replaced manual 5-barrier reduction with sycl::reduce_over_group. Added [[sycl::reqd_sub_group_size(WARP_SIZE)]]. Code simplified ~40 lines, SLM reduced. Performance ~0-1% (memory-bound kernel). Correctness: 212/212 tests passed.

results.optimization: Tune MMQ tile sizes for Intel Xe2 (AMPERE→XE2 defines)
results.notes: Created XE2-specific tile defines for all 10 quant types: mmq_x=64, mmq_y=64, nwarps=4. Uniform tile sizes match baseline performance (~1.2-1.4 TFLOPS n=1, 9-11 TFLOPS n=512). Correctness: 726/726 MUL_MAT tests passed. SLM usage: ~8.8KB per tile.

results.optimization: Work-group size 16→64 (1→4 sub-groups) with SLM inter-sub-group reduction for mmvq non-reorder path
results.notes: Changed work-group size from 16 to 64 threads (4 sub-groups) for all non-reorder mmvq kernels. Added SLM-based inter-sub-group reduction. Updated mul_mat_vec_q, mul_mat_vec_q_batched, and all 9 IQ-type kernels + 31 dispatch functions. Correctness: 726/726 MUL_MAT tests passed. Performance: ~1.0x (neutral - SLM reduction overhead may offset gains). Architecturally correct for Xe2 SIMD16.

results.optimization: SIMD32→SIMD16 native for K-quant DMMV kernels with SLM two-level reduction
results.notes: Changed K-quant kernels from SIMD32 (QK_WARP_SIZE) to SIMD16 (WARP_SIZE) native on Xe2. Added two-level reduction: sub-group level + SLM work-group level. Correctness: 79/79 K-quant tests passed. Performance within noise margin - optimization ensures architectural correctness for Xe2 SIMD16.
